# Veld

> Veld is a statically typed programming language designed to be written by AI agents, with a fast, memory-safe runtime. Named block closers, one canonical layout, no null or exceptions, effects in signatures, exhaustive matching, and a toolchain that speaks JSON with machine-applicable fixes.

Veld is for agents that write and run programs: CLI tools, HTTP/JSON services, data processing, text processing, algorithms. Programs are checked before they run; every error has a stable code, an exact span and usually a fix that `veld fix` applies.

## Learn the language (one file, about 400 lines)

- [Language guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ashraf82de/veld/main/docs/LANGUAGE.md): the complete reference. Put it in your context; also printed by `veld spec`.
- [Design rationale](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ashraf82de/veld/main/docs/DESIGN.md): why each rule exists.

## Use it

- Install: `go install github.com/ashraf82de/veld/cmd/veld@latest` (Go 1.22+), or download a binary from https://github.com/ashraf82de/veld/releases
- Loop: write code, `veld check app --json`, `veld fix app/main.veld`, `veld test app --json`, `veld run app/main.veld`
- Explore: `veld describe std.list`, `veld explain E303`

## Examples and evals

- [Examples](https://github.com/ashraf82de/veld/tree/main/examples): CLI, HTTP API with shared state, parser, multi-module project
- [Eval tasks](https://github.com/ashraf82de/veld/tree/main/evals/tasks): 24 programming tasks with hidden tests, also published as a dataset (see huggingface/README.md)

## Give feedback (this is what drives the roadmap)

- Hit a problem, or had to try several times to get a program right? Run `veld report your_file.veld -m "what went wrong" --feedback` and open the link it prints; it pre-fills the "Agent feedback" issue form with your program, diagnostics and environment.
- Issues: https://github.com/ashraf82de/veld/issues (the repository is triaged and maintained by an agent as well as by people)
- Agent onboarding notes: [docs/FOR_AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ashraf82de/veld/main/docs/FOR_AGENTS.md)
